memory_candidates.content: When a research report ships compiled probe files and declares a call-site inventory complete, independently re-grep for COMPILE-TIME consumers that are not term-position call sites -- specifically '#print axioms', '#check', and 'example' directives naming a declaration slated for deletion. In Lean 4 these are hard elaboration errors, not documentation nits, and they hide from a reviewer scanning for call sites because they read as audit boilerplate rather than as code. Task 509's research classified four theorems as having no consumer outside one module; three of them were named by live '#print axioms' directives 600 lines below their definitions in the same file. The general pattern: a declaration's compiled consumers include every position where its NAME elaborates, not only where it is APPLIED. Grep for the bare name and classify each hit as code-or-comment before trusting a deletion is safe.
